results.title: Release delivery and public cutover
results.summary: Implemented deterministic release freshness manifests for evidence/review inputs and explicit owner-selected scheduling timezone resolution with UTC/offset confirmation. Added regression coverage for stale in-place evidence/finding changes, scheduled delivery refusal, DST/invalid schedule rejection, and workspace timezone scheduling. — The prior cycle blockers are addressed: readiness now checks active same-revision review/reconciliation work before release, and evidence manifests include/normalize blank restriction reasons. The implementation matches the Phase 5 retry requirements sufficiently for commit readiness.

results.title: Root Admin invitations
results.summary: Implemented the root Admin invitation command, provisioning action, notification, Admin reset response/view, bootstrap role config, and auth coverage for broker-backed password setup. — Cycle 2 addresses the prior high-severity testing gaps for unsafe mailers, delivery retry semantics, and reset-token edge cases, and the stray context-map artifact is no longer in the diff. Remaining issues are non-blocking spec/test coverage refinements, so the implementation is ready to commit once those are accepted or cleaned up.
findings: medium/spec-deviation app/Actions/Admin/InviteAdministrator.php:158 — Mailer safety preflight hard-codes accepted transports instead of using the MailManager/Symfony APIs specified for effective transport validation → Refactor preflight to use Laravel's mail transport resolution while still recursively rejecting log/array failover and roundrobin members

medium/testing tests/Feature/Auth/AdminInvitationTest.php:50 — Invitation email coverage checks the default test origin and encoded email, but does not verify nondefault Admin ports or the broker expiry text required by the spec → Add a case with a nondefault admin.url port and custom broker expiry and assert both appear correctly

medium/testing tests/Feature/Auth/AdminInvitationTest.php:99 — Missing-role preflight is covered, but malformed invitation email input is not tested despite the spec requiring invalid input to produce no account or role changes → Add an invalid-email command test asserting failure, no user, and no notification
